Annihilape.why: Rage Fist is the move that made Annihilape a Showdown staple: 50 power, +50 every time Ape is hit (up to 350). Across all 113 Chapter 8 boss mons it one-shots 67 after one hit and 83 after two. Sucker Punch gives priority.
Annihilape.style: Lead that wants to get hit: let it take a hit, then Rage Fist hits like a truck. Protect does not count as a hit.

Gholdengo.why: Power Gem (Lv 49) hits the Fire types that resist Make It Rain (Typhlosion, Camerupt, Arcanine at Amber and Geara & Zetta): +4 one-shots. Replaces Recover; Protect stays for doubles.

Rhyperior.why: Stone Edge replaces Rock Slide: +6 one-shots, and 1.5x on Mountain and Volcanic Top.

Glaceon.why: Nothing better unlocks. The relearner only adds weak moves (Ice Shard, Swift).

Golisopod-Aevian.why: Already the meta set. Skill Link multi-hits plus Swords Dance; nothing beats it.

Leavanny-Aevian.why: Support set stays. Its relearner moves (Swords Dance, Dragon Rush) don't fit a redirector.

Arcanine.why: Flare Blitz (relearner) is its Showdown signature: 120-power Fire STAB, replacing Fire Fang. Protect over Play Rough because it now leads in doubles.

Azumarill.why: Huge Power needs physical STABs. Aqua Tail (Lv 21) and Play Rough (Lv 25) replace Hydro Pump and Double-Edge; Protect replaces Rain Dance. The Showdown Belly Drum + Aqua Jet set needs a bred Marill (egg moves).

Camerupt.why: Eruption (relearner) at full HP is 150 power and hits both foes in doubles: jumps Camerupt from B to A tier. Needs a Modest mint (it's special); Earth Power (Lv 26) replaces Earthquake.

Chandelure.why: Overheat (relearner) replaces Incinerate for real Fire damage; Will-O-Wisp (relearner) cripples physical bosses instead of Hex.

Crabominable.why: Close Combat (Lv 49) replaces Brick Break: 120 power instead of 75.

Crawdaunt.why: Knock Off hits harder than Crunch against item holders (every boss mon) and removes the item. Adaptability Crabhammer replaces Razor Shell.

Crobat.why: Tailwind (relearner) doubles your side's Speed for 4 turns: Crobat becomes a doubles speed-control lead. Replaces Quick Attack.

Cursola.why: Strength Sap (Lv 35) heals and lowers the target's Attack; Shadow Ball (TM30) for STAB. Night Shade, Grudge and Mirror Coat go. Needs a Modest mint.

Drapion-Aevian.why: Icicle Crash gives it strong Ice STAB on its Fur Coat body; Gunk Shot and Knock Off cover the rest.

Feraligatr.why: Agility (Lv 1) plus Sheer Force turns it into a sweeper: one boost outspeeds every boss mon. Crunch (Lv 32) replaces Thrash and Hydro Pump. Needs an Adamant mint.

Glalie-Aevian.why: Grassy Glide (relearner) is priority in Grassy Terrain. Capsule to Grassy Surge and it sets the terrain itself, so it hits first every turn and heals: its best score (A tier). Replaces Double-Edge.

Golem.why: Earthquake (Lv 40) replaces Rock Blast for Ground STAB.

Jellicent.why: Recover (Lv 28) keeps HP high, and Water Spout is strongest at full HP. Replaces Hydro Pump.

Klawf.why: Rock Blast (Lv 24) replaces X-Scissor: STAB multi-hit after Swords Dance.

Lapras-Aevian.why: Zen Headbutt (Lv 35) adds Psychic STAB to the Dragon Dance set. No Guard Sing still never misses. Replaces Protect.

Lunatone-Idol.why: Moonblast (relearner) hits Dragons, Dark and Fighting. Replaces Protect, since Focus Sash already keeps it alive.

Musharna-Aevian.why: Moonlight (relearner) gives it recovery, which a bulky Trick Room setter wants. Replaces Yawn.

Pangoro.why: Sky Uppercut and Bullet Punch (relearner) replace Low Sweep and Body Slam: stronger Fighting STAB plus priority.

Passimian.why: Bulk Up (Lv 35) replaces Double-Edge. Defiant plus Bulk Up snowballs.

Porygon-Z.why: Nasty Plot (relearner) is the Showdown set: +2 Special Attack on Adaptability Tri Attack. Shadow Ball (TM30) and Discharge (Lv 40) cover Ghosts and Steels. Agility, Recover and Protect go.

Runerigus.why: Physical attacker: Shadow Claw replaces Shadow Ball and Slam, and Curse makes it a slow tank that grows. Needs an Adamant mint.

Slowbro.why: Slack Off (Lv 33) is Slowbro's standard recovery. Replaces Brine.

Solrock-Idol.why: Flare Blitz (relearner) replaces Rock Slide: Fire coverage, its best score.

Sylveon.why: Pixilate turns Swift (Lv 20) into a Fairy move that hits both foes: a spread move before Hyper Voice. Shadow Ball (TM30) replaces Draining Kiss.

Throh.why: Storm Throw (always crits), Bulk Up and Wide Guard (doubles) all unlock. Replaces Seismic Toss, Endure and Reversal.

Zoroark.why: Nasty Plot (Lv 52) replaces Agility: +2 Special Attack behind Illusion. Gets much stronger with its Chapter 8 crest.

Meowscarada.why: Knock Off (Lv 52) replaces Night Slash: harder hits against item holders, and it removes the item.
